transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, my wife is the one who made the appointment. She... what finally scared her is that I keep hearing things in the house. I hear water running, and men whispering inside the walls when nobody is there. And sometimes I look and see this dark wet patch spreading across the hallway. I've gone over and checked it, and the floor is completely dry, but... I still see it. So, she wanted me to come talk to someone.
Have you been feeling unusually energized, irritable, or deeply depressed for a period of time recently?

Not energized, no. It's... it's definitely the depressed part. Most days, I wake up already feeling like I’ve failed at being a husband, and just a man in general. And that heaviness, it just sits on me the whole day, right up until I go back to bed.
Have you experienced these voices and visions only during the times when you feel this deep depression, or do they happen even when your mood is relatively okay?

It's only been during this time. Before the house problems dragged on and I fell into this depression, I never experienced anything like this. I never heard voices in the walls, or saw wet patches that weren't there, or... or thought the neighbors were tracking me. None of that. 

Those things, they only showed up after I had already stopped caring about my usual life. It was only after I started feeling like a failure every day that the voices and the visions started happening. So, no, they don't happen when my mood is okay. Just recently, with all this heaviness.
Have you ever experienced a period of deep, persistent depression like this in the past, perhaps years ago?

No, I haven't. I mean, everyone has bad days, or maybe a rough week here and there, but... nothing like this. I've never felt this kind of constant heaviness before, not even years ago. This is the first time it's been this bad.
When you hear the whispering or see the wet patch, do you believe that these are real, physical things happening in your home, or do you have a sense that they might just be in your mind?

No, I... I believe they are real. I know it probably sounds far-fetched when I say it out loud to you, but I am certain of it. The mold and the bad wiring in that house, they've actually poisoned everything I own. It's not just my imagination. And the neighbors... I can tell they are watching me, just waiting to see when I mess up again. So, yes, it feels very real to me.
